usageNotes: Use this endpoint to list all datastores visible to a specific node along with their live capacity metrics (total, used, available bytes). The node must be online — offline nodes return no storage status. Results are filtered by the caller's permissions: only storages where the caller holds 'Datastore.Audit' or 'Datastore.AllocateSpace' on '/storage/<storage>' will appear.

examples.summary: List only ISO-capable, enabled storages on node pve1

tips: The 'active' field in each result indicates whether the storage is currently reachable/mounted, which can differ from 'enabled' (config-level toggle).
Use the 'target' param when planning a VM migration: it restricts results to shared storages accessible by both the source node and the target node.
Set 'format=true' to get the list of supported disk image formats (qcow2, raw, vmdk, subvol) — useful before provisioning a new VM disk.
Capacity fields (avail, used, total) may be absent for storage types that do not report usage (e.g. some directory stores or external backends that are unreachable).
